guarantees: company_id is mandatory and candidate discovery never crosses company boundaries
discovery generates feasible candidates and alternatives but does not rank, recommend, approve or execute them
each option has provenance, discovery rationale, confidence, feasibility state and constraint/evidence references
canonical entity references remain references; option discovery does not rewrite entity identity
duplicate candidates from different providers are consolidated without deleting source provenance
hard-constraint failures remain inspectable and are excluded from eligible options by default
do_nothing, investigate, escalate and defer may be represented as ordinary action/resolution options when meaningful
unknown feasibility stays explicit rather than being treated as feasible
option generation may use contextual enrichment but cannot infer execution authority from provider data
